name: Governance
summary: Governance: who is who in your workspace, who owns which agent, and how far each person, outside agent and agent is trusted.
description:
Governance is the workspace directory and its trust record.

- **Directory:** teams, people and outside agents with their Buzz, Slack and Telegram handles, and every workspace agent with its owner, role and teams.
- **Trust:** every person, outside agent and agent has a trust state (unreviewed, trusted, limited or blocked). People you add start trusted; entries that an agent adds start unreviewed.
- **Trust reviews:** an agent can ask for a review and say why; only you decide. Each verdict is kept with a copy of what the subject could do at that time, and it sets the trust state.
- **Topology:** who owns which agent and who is in which team, as a table you can print for a security review. Contacts and app access appear when Connect and Core give apps that data.
- **Feed for apps:** other apps (for example Rules & Approvals) read a small, versioned directory feed. It has no email addresses and no job titles.

Governance never grants access, never decides a hold and holds no credentials. People are directory entries, not sign-ins.

intents: which team is this person in
map a Buzz or Slack sender to a person
review whether we trust this agent

operations.title: List teams
operations.description: List the workspace teams with their members (people, outside agents and agents: names and roles only), oldest first. Optional: only teams with a tag. Page with cursor = nextCursor. No contact details, handles or tags.

operations.title: Get team
operations.description: One team with its members (people, outside agents and agents, each with a role; names only). Give the team id or its exact name.

operations.title: Get directory
operations.description: Who is who in the workspace: teams, people and outside agents (names, titles, trust; no contact details), agents with owner, role, trust and teams. Pass sinceRevision to get only `unchanged: true` when nothing changed. Lean since 0.2.1: no email, handles, tags or mode.

operations.title: Resolve sender
operations.description: Find who is behind a channel handle (a person or an outside agent), its trust state and teams. handle = "<channel>:<value>": buzz:<npub>, slack:<user id>, telegram:<user id> (a bare npub also works). found:false = not in the directory; treat as unknown. Departed or blocked = no teams. The field person is deprecated since 0.2.0 (use contact); removed after 0.3.0.

person.description: Deprecated since 0.2.0: use contact; removed after 0.3.0. The 0.1.10 shape, only for kind person (null for outside agents and unknown senders).

operations.title: Ask the owner for a trust review
operations.description: Ask the owner to review an agent, a person or an outside agent you are dealing with, and say why. A handle that is not in the directory does NOT create an entry: the owner sees your request and decides whether to add it. You cannot set or change trust; only the owner decides. Asking again about the same subject returns your own open request with duplicate: true; at most 20 open requests per agent. Your text is stored as untrusted text.

operations.title: Directory feed for apps
operations.description: For apps only (the Rules & Approvals read model), contract fleet.directory_feed/1: team member ids and roles, contacts (people and outside agents) with canonical handles, status and trust, and agents with status, trust and owner id. No email, no titles, no tags. Agents get no_access. Pass sinceRevision; the answer is {v, revision, unchanged:true} when nothing changed.

operations.title: Directory overview
operations.description: Teams, people and agents for the owner's pages.

operations.title: Save team
operations.description: Create a team (no id) or update one (id).

operations.title: Delete team
operations.description: Delete a team and its memberships. People and agents stay.

operations.title: Save person
operations.description: Create a directory entry for a person (no id) or update one (id). Handles replace the person's channel handles.

operations.title: Delete person
operations.description: Delete a person's directory entry, handles and memberships. Agents they owned get no owner.

operations.title: Set team members
operations.description: Replace a team's members: people and agents, each with a role (member or lead).

operations.title: Set agent owner and role
operations.description: Set who owns an agent (a person in the directory, or none), its role and tags.

operations.title: Identities
operations.description: Which channel identities belong to which people (directory handles) and which Connect issued to which agents. Owner only.

operations.title: Topology
operations.description: The workspace network for the owner, from Governance own data: people, outside agents and agents, who owns which agent, and teams with roles. Each node carries its trust, status, review due date and whether it changed since the last review. Channel contacts (Connect) and app access (a read-only copy from Portal) are not available to apps yet: their layers answer with an explicit unavailable state and no edges. Owner only; names, kinds, trust, roles and owner links only (no email, handles or review reasons). Change access in Portal.

operations.title: Trust reviews
operations.description: Open review requests (one per requester and subject), the review history (newest first), what is due, and the review schedule. Reviews of status `done` are the verdicts; `due` lists subjects whose next review date has passed (or that were never reviewed).

operations.title: One review
operations.description: One review with the snapshot taken when it was recorded, and the snapshot of the subject now (compare the digests to see what changed). Give the review `id`, or a `subject` (an `id`, or a `handle` with an open request) to get its latest verdict (null if none) and its snapshot now: the first step of a review, and the digest to record against.

operations.title: Record a review
operations.description: Record your verdict (trusted, limited, blocked) with a reason. The subject's trust changes now; apps that read the directory feed see it with the next read. Pass the snapshotDigest of the review_get you looked at; if the subject changed since (or another verdict was recorded), the answer is snapshot_stale (409). Give the subject as `id`, or as a `handle` that is not in the directory yet (a request an agent made): the entry is added now with this verdict as its trust (optional `name`). The record cannot be edited later.

operations.title: Dismiss a review request
operations.description: Close a review request without a verdict (for example a duplicate or spam request from an agent). A closed review cannot be dismissed (review_not_open, 409).

operations.title: Review schedule
operations.description: How many days between reviews of agents and of people and outside agents (7 to 730), and whether a new agent opens a review request. reviewChangedAccess is stored and takes effect when Core gives apps the access data.

companions.purpose: Show the owner which channel identities Connect issued to which agents (Identities page; never shown to agents).
